calculateDP scores = dp
  where

    dp = foldl' updateDP (replicate n 0) [1..n]
    updateDP dp' i
      | i == 1 = take (i + 1) $ zipWith (+) dp' scores
      | i == 2 = take (i + 1) $ zipWith (+) (zipWith (+) dp' scores) (tail scores)
